decision.summary: Relation endpoint editing is rebuilt in the Universal Cell authority as exact incidence/interface rewiring. The browser selector now renders and submits exact interface cell ids instead of owner/domain ids, eliminating ambiguous owner-level topology guesses.

authority_files.evidence: Relation presenter repeats endpoint options from the selected incidence rewire_choices and binds select value to participant_interface.
Browser change handler accepts only exact rewire choice ids; owner fallback was removed.
Browser probe drives relation rewire by exact interface id.
Canonical court proves rewiring replaces one exact incidence, preserves relation identity, updates public interface ownership, and rejects invisible endpoints without partial mutation.
Browser court now requires relation endpoint controls to expose exact participant_interface values.

commands.command: python -m pytest tests_replica\test_universal_ui_interactions.py -q --timeout=180 -k "real_nary_relation_incidence_cables_reach_real_role_sockets or relation_role_control_submits_only_its_graph_lease_and_event_fact or incidence_socket_drag_rewires_the_exact_relation_role or role_socket_drag_appends_only_when_cardinality_has_capacity or selected_relation_exposes_real_endpoints_gates_and_presentation or wire_endpoint_rewire"

not_claimed: This does not make the full application complete.
This does not promote ignored node_runtime or BABOOM v4 code as authority.
